faces.name: Rule of Law
faces.oracleText: Each player can't cast more than one spell each turn.

faces.name: Rule with an Even Hand
faces.oracleText:
(Start the game with this conspiracy face up in the command zone.)
You can't attack with an odd number of creatures.
Whenever you attack, double target creature's power until end of turn.

faces.name: Rules Lawyer
faces.oracleText: State-based actions don't apply to you or other permanents you control. (You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life or drawing from an empty library. Your creatures aren't destroyed due to damage or deathtouch and aren't put into a graveyard due to having 0 or less toughness. Your planeswalkers aren't put into a graveyard if they have 0 loyalty. You don't put a legendary permanent into a graveyard if you control two with the same name. Counters aren't removed from your permanents due to game rules. Permanents you control attached or combined illegally remain on the battlefield. For complete rules and regulations, see rule 704.)

faces.name: Rules of Acquisition
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Follow the 3rd Rule — Gain control of target nonland permanent an opponent controls. That opponent draws three cards.
• Follow the 98th Rule — Target opponent gains control of target nonland permanent you control. If they do, you draw three cards.
